ai.overallExplanation: The summary incorrectly states that a payment was made during the call. The customer explicitly said they had not paid anything that day, and the agent confirmed no payment had been taken.

transcriptEvidence.quote: Correct, no payment has been taken today.

findings.explanation: The summary records a payment as made, but the transcript confirms that no payment was made or taken during the call. The £60 payment was a future commitment for 23 October.
findings.suggestedCorrection: Replace “Payment made” with “No payment was made during the call.”

ai.suggestedSummary: DPA completed. The company called and reached the customer, and arrears were discussed. A failed washing machine cost £340, which the customer paid using money reserved for the car instalment. The customer agreed to pay £60 by bank transfer on 23 October using their account reference; no payment was made during the call. The customer understood the arrangement, and the company will call on 27 October after 10 am to review receipt and the remaining arrears.
